name: Implement quantity-based tiered pricing
query: Add tiered pricing: 5+ items get 10% off, 10+ items get 20% off, per product. It must work in the Cart block too.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Store tiers via product data fields saved through woocommerce_admin_process_product_object
Step 3: Set prices in woocommerce_before_calculate_totals from the original product price (idempotent)
Step 5: Expose savings to the Cart block via Store API endpoint data instead of HTML filters
success_criteria: Recalculating the cart twice does not compound the discount
Works with the Cart/Checkout blocks and the classic cart
